answer: Each agent ID must pass a weekly live challenge where a random peer panel sends it a fresh task, such as tagging sable fur listings or tracing a velvet supplier's ledger, and expects a signed answer within ninety seconds. One operator running forty fakes has to field forty simultaneous tasks from separate panels. Answers can't be cached because every prompt is new, and if two IDs submit matching reasoning, both get flagged. The nebula of fakes therefore needs a real model call and real compute per ID, every week, and that bill grows linearly with headcount.
